title: Procedural rulings and decisions on the merits
shortTitle: Procedural rulings and decisions on the merits
summary: A procedural ruling decides how or whether litigation may proceed. A merits determination decides the parties’ underlying legal entitlement, although some motions can resolve that entitlement without trial.
notes: Jurisdictional objections, pleading defects, and evidentiary insufficiency have different consequences. A label such as dismissal must be tied to its ground and posture.

sections.Meaning: A procedural ruling decides how or whether litigation may proceed. A merits determination decides the parties’ underlying legal entitlement, although some motions can resolve that entitlement without trial.
sections.How to work through the question: For each case, identify the challenged motion, what facts the court could consider, which assertions were assumed rather than found, and exactly what the appellate disposition required. Reversal of dismissal may reopen litigation; it does not ordinarily establish liability or the amount of damages.
